items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story about Jerry Lieber and Mike Stoller writing 'Hound Dog' and working with Elvis Presley, citing a 'recent book' and quotes from Lieber. There is no indication of a personal relationship between Chuck Mancuso and Jerry Lieber.

ctx.x: Mama Thornton. 1952. Lieber and Stoller. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
